shared_elements: horizontal band/register of repeated short vertical strokes
row of repeated rounded elements (dots/cupmarks vs. arch-loops)
schematic animal or quadruped figures in profile
small human-like figure with outstretched limbs
justification: Both surfaces organise schematic figures into stacked horizontal registers and both contain a band of closely spaced vertical strokes and a run of repeated rounded elements (A's line of cupmark-dots, B's row of arched loops), which is the most specific correspondence. The decisive difference is technique and idiom: A is flat red pigment painting of boats and stick-like humans on a rough natural rock face, while B is modelled low-relief carving of naturalistic birds and quadrupeds on a dressed, free-standing block, so the manner of rendering has essentially nothing in common.
